Mike Webb chased home Cambridge Harriers' Keith Penny in the British Heart Foundation 10k. His time of 33:30 put him just 9 seconds behind the winner.

He took the VAC title and beat Keith Penny into the bargain. His 2:44:44 in the London Marathon gave him the bronze medal in the Belgrave Championship and a cracking second leg run in the National Veterans' Road Relay at Aldershot brought the Bels. a very exciting and rare (although brief) lead.
